datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Mauritania to collect Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data for 2021. IPC classifications were spatially mapped by administrative or livelihood zones and aggregated into medium-term projections across multiple scenarios to assess food insecurity severity and geographic distribution.
